episodes.name: The Trip (1)
episodes.overview: Jerry and George look for Kramer in Hollywood, where Kramer's new friend becomes a victim.

episodes.name: The Trip (2)
episodes.overview: Jerry and George find Kramer, whose past is laid out by the lieutenant seeking his confession.

episodes.name: The Pitch
episodes.overview: A show about "nothing" is George's pitch to network execs interested in a series for Jerry.

episodes.name: The Ticket
episodes.overview: Jerry and George take another meeting; Kramer testifies for Newman in a speeding-ticket protest.

episodes.name: The Wallet
episodes.overview: Jerry's dad has a bad time at the back doctor's; Elaine wants to part with her boyfriend; Jerry's unhappy with George's network "negotiating."

episodes.name: The Watch
episodes.overview: The network president doesn't play George's game; Jerry deals for his "broken" watch; Elaine is a hot topic in the office of her psychiatrist boyfriend.

episodes.name: The Bubble Boy
episodes.overview: A weekend is kaput, partly because of George's driving.

episodes.name: The Cheever Letters
episodes.overview: Elaine's assistant has words with Jerry, who has few with George; Kramer deals for more Cuban cigars.

episodes.name: The Opera
episodes.overview: The man who's threatening Jerry is the same Joe who's dating Elaine.

episodes.name: The Virgin
episodes.overview: Jerry courts a woman with a tame past; George makes a bad move at a meeting; a man disagrees with Elaine.

episodes.name: The Contest
episodes.overview: George's mom lands in the hospital; a contest begins among Jerry, George, Kramer and Elaine, involving a naked woman and an attractive man.

episodes.name: The Airport
episodes.overview: On a flight to NYC, Jerry has a first-class time, but Elaine suffers in coach. Meanwhile, Kramer and George try to hit the right airport.

episodes.name: The Pick
episodes.overview: Kramer makes Elaine's Christmas card a collector's item, and settles an argument with a designer; Jerry is caught in a human moment by his new female friend; George pleads to make up with Susan.

episodes.name: The Movie
episodes.overview: The difficulties met by four persons trying to meet at one movie.

episodes.name: The Visa
episodes.overview: A lawyer George dates could help Jerry's pal, who's facing deportation, thanks, in part, to Kramer's trip to Florida.

episodes.name: The Shoes
episodes.overview: There's something about Elaine's shoes that leads to the stalling of George and Jerry's TV pilot, until Elaine gives it a kick.

episodes.name: The Outing
episodes.overview: Elaine's prank leads a reporter to believe Jerry and George are a gay couple.

episodes.name: The Old Man
episodes.overview: Volunteering with seniors...Elaine is enthralled by hers, George gets fired and Jerry loses his.

episodes.name: The Implant
episodes.overview: Jerry adopts Elaine's opinion about a woman he's seeing; then Elaine changes her mind.

episodes.name: The Junior Mint
episodes.overview: Jerry can't remember the name of his date, and he observes a splenectomy.

episodes.name: The Smelly Car
episodes.overview: An odor in Jerry's car seeps into the love life of Elaine.

episodes.name: The Handicap Spot
episodes.overview: There are many repercussions after the gang parks in a handicap space.

episodes.name: The Pilot (1)
episodes.overview: Kramer wants to audition for Jerry and George's pilot; and the network president becomes obsessed with Elaine.

episodes.name: The Pilot (2)
episodes.overview: The pilot is cast, taped and aired, but George doesn't think he'll live to see its success.
